messages:
anna_cs: Quick heads-up — Meridian EBR on Wed 04/06 11:00am PT. We need a short exec playbook rehearsal tomorrow 10:00am PT. Please confirm slide ownership + run order.

mike_ae: I can take the opening exec context and renewal ask slide. link to latest deck?

anna_cs: Deck here: https://redwood-co.slideshare.net/meridian-ebr-v3 (latest is in the 'final' tab) — mike_ae you have slide 1-3.

julie_eng: Will take the technical risks + mitigation slide. FYI the demo relies on staging cluster v2; I need confirmation that staging will be stable.

sam_ops: Staging v2 smoke scheduled tonight 8pm PT. If anything fails I'll ping here. :wrench:

luis_csm: Assigning presenters: @mike_ae (exec context), @luis_csm (customer health + revenue), @julie_eng (tech risks), @anna_cs (ops/next steps). Can everyone ack?

mike_ae: ack :thumbsup:

julie_eng: ack. I'll bring 2 backup slides in case demo fails.

anna_cs: Also want to run a 12-minute dry demo and a 3-slide backup for if we need to pivot. Agenda below — please read and add comments tonight.

anna_cs: ```
Run of show (10am rehearsal)
- 00:00-02:00: intro + exec ask (mike_ae)
- 02:00-05:00: customer health & renewals (luis_csm)
- 05:00-08:00: demo (julie_eng) + fallback slides (julie_eng)
- 08:00-09:30: ops/next steps (anna_cs)
- 09:30-10:00: Q&A + action item capture
```

qbr-bot: Reminder set: dry-run tomorrow 10:00am PT -> Calendar invite sent to channel attendees.

sam_ops: Quick ask — please upload any GIF/embedded assets for the deck to the shared folder by EOD so we can vet load times.

luis_csm: Noted. I'll consolidate open asks and risks into the action tracker. Quick risk callout: renewal talk track needs a clear ask and timeline — Mike, can you draft the renewal ask phrasing?

mike_ae: Yep — I'll post a proposed script by 6pm PT.

anna_cs: Action items (captured):
- mike_ae -> draft renewal ask script (by 6pm PT)
- julie_eng -> demo fallback slides + staging readiness confirmation (by EOD)
- sam_ops -> smoke test + report (8pm PT)
- luis_csm -> finalize action tracker & send pre-read (by 9pm PT)
- anna_cs -> run rehearsal & capture final slide order (tomorrow 10am)

luis_csm: I'll also attach customer feedback snippets to slide 2 (health) — pulling from last 30 days NPS/comments.

julie_eng: FYI if the staging smoke finds perf regressions we have a quick mitigation: toggle feature_flag=demo_mode (low risk) — will test tonight.

anna_cs: Perfect. If anyone can't make the 10am rehearsal ping here and suggest alternate. Otherwise see you all then. :eyes:

mike_ae: One more thing — would be useful to have a 1-slide appendix of cost/perf improvements we delivered this quarter. I'll draft one and add to the 'appendix' tab.

sam_ops: Added — please review in the shared folder.

qbr-bot: dry-run started (10:00am PT) — channel thread pinned.

anna_cs: Rehearsal complete. Notes: demo had a 1.2s median tail latency spike, julie to follow up with root cause. mike — your renewal ask phrasing looks good, luis please incorporate into slide 4.

julie_eng: Root cause is an autoscaler edge case; I'll open a short incident and attach remediation ETA (tomorrow EOD).

luis_csm: Incorporated Mike's phrasing, sent updated deck link. Final send to execs scheduled for Wed 8:30am PT.

anna_cs: Closing the loop — final checklist before exec send: deck updated, appendix added, demo fallback ready, smoke test green. If any blockers by 7am Wed ping me.

mike_ae: Thanks team. :rocket:
